scale_cues: Square white dinner plate with rounded corners, assumed about 25-27 cm per side, sitting on a tray; salad covers roughly the left half of the plate, rice and chicken the right half. No cutlery or hand in frame.
assumptions: Plate assumed to be a standard ~26 cm square dinner plate; all masses scale with that assumption
Chicken assumed skin-on with some bone in the smaller piece; grams are edible meat and skin only
Rice assumed to be plain brown rice with no added fat; some rice is hidden under the chicken and salad
White crumbles assumed to be feta; could be blue cheese or goat cheese
Round yellow-green items in the salad assumed to be chickpeas; could be small olives or marinated beans
Pale translucent chunks assumed to be raw onion; could be artichoke heart or fennel
Dressing and cooking oil are not clearly visible and are inferred from sheen and preparation
Sesame seeds or grain bits on the leaves (under 5 g) are ignored
